Example: Profit calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Asset class: Stocks
  • Direction: Long (buy)
  • Entry price: $150
  • Exit price: $165
  • Quantity: 50 shares
  • Leverage: 1 ×
  • Fees: $ per side
  • Fee: $0

The calculator returns:

  • Net profit: +$750.00 (+10% price move)
  • Return: +10%
  • Position value: $7,500 (50 × $150.00)
  • Fees: $0.00
  • Break-even exit: $150.00 (0% from entry)
